reason: It is not even launched and the FINTRAC registration is only 'in process', so I would not put pension money through it. At about $342 on a 10 lakh move, 2 percent is well above what I expect to pay when I compare Wise, Remitly and my bank to the paisa.
objection: Which bank actually holds my money, and is this regulated? FINTRAC is still pending and I have no name for the Indian partner bank. On top of that, 2 percent is steep for a transfer I could shop around.
would_change_my_mind: Completed FINTRAC registration, a named Indian partner bank, and a total fee under about 1 percent (roughly CAD 160 on 10 lakh), shown as a live rate against Wise.
